# [STORY] As a developer, I want the frontend to run on Vite instead of CRA, so that I have a supported, fast toolchain

## User Story
**As a** developer
**I want** the Filmpire frontend to build and serve via Vite instead of CRA (react-scripts)
**So that** the toolchain is actively maintained, HMR is instant, and we are not pinned to an abandoned build system

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given the repo is checked out, when `npm run dev` is executed, then the app starts via Vite (not react-scripts) and opens in the browser without errors.
- [x] Given the repo is checked out, when `npm run build` is executed, then Vite produces a production bundle in `dist/` with no build errors.
- [x] Given the existing test suite, when `npm test` is executed, then all tests pass under Vitest. — 166 pass, 2 skipped (pre-existing jsdom hang, tracked in #132, unrelated to the Vite migration itself).
- [x] Given the migration is complete, when `npm ls react-scripts` is run, then react-scripts is not present in the dependency tree.
- [x] Given the CI frontend workflow, when a push triggers it, then the Vite build step passes. — Unblocked by #131 (frontend-ci.yml's CRA-era `--watchAll=false`/`--audit-level=high` flags fixed). Full CI sequence (install/lint/audit/test+coverage/build) verified green locally.
